ceo_directive_5_response: In-vitro flow-loop specification to prove CSF flow, retention, permeability, fouling, pressure, bypass
purpose: Validate the engineering simulation (V3 FINAL Phase F) against physical data

test_article_definition.device: eShunt prototype with ePTFE membrane sleeve (ARCH-001 design)
test_article_definition.membrane: ePTFE, 50um thick, 0.05um pore, 30 kDa MWCO (W.L. Gore)
test_article_definition.quantity: n=10 prototypes (5 for flow testing, 3 for fouling, 2 spare)

flow_conditions.fluid: Artificial CSF (aCSF) — composition: NaCl 150mM, KCl 3mM, CaCl2 1.2mM, MgCl2 0.8mM, NaH2PO4 0.5mM, NaHCO3 25mM, glucose 2.8mM, pH 7.33

fouling_protocol.fluid: aCSF + 4 g/L albumin (simulates CSF protein concentration)
fouling_protocol.endpoint: 90% fouling (per simulation) or 12 weeks, whichever first

failure_injections.method: Inject 100uL fibrin clot at membrane inlet

failure_injections.expected: Flow decreases linearly, bypass activates at 90% fouling
Bypass fails open (drainage preserved) or closed (ICP rises)

bypass_testing.activation_pressure: Measure exact dP when bypass opens (target: 15±2 mmHg)
bypass_testing.response_time: Time from dP threshold to bypass open (target: <1s)
bypass_testing.residual_flow: Flow rate when bypass open (target: ≥0.30 mL/min)
bypass_testing.recovery: Does bypass close when dP drops? (target: yes, <5s)
bypass_testing.repeatability: Cycle 100 times, measure activation pressure each time (target: ±1 mmHg)

icp_surrogate_measurement.method: Inlet pressure transducer (0-50 mmHg range, ±0.5 mmHg accuracy)
icp_surrogate_measurement.data_logged: Inlet pressure, outlet pressure, differential, flow rate, bypass state

acceptance_criteria.test: Measure albumin concentration inlet vs outlet

acceptance_criteria.target: ≤8 mmHg at 0% fouling (≤1 mmHg above baseline)
Closes <5s after dP drops below threshold

statistical_plan.failure_handling: If any unit fails, root-cause analysis + design iteration

equipment_required: Flow loop pump (Harvard Apparatus PHD Ultra)
